svg.title: Viral Video Chopper — full request pipeline
svg.desc: Step-by-step flow from URL paste through transcript, AI processing, clip generation, and download

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should the URL input form look like in Viral Video Chopper?')
sendPrompt('How do I check if a video URL is already cached in MongoDB?')
sendPrompt('How do I call the transcript API with a YouTube URL?')
sendPrompt('What prompt do I send to Grok AI to generate hooks, hashtags, and captions?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement HuggingFace as a fallback when Grok fails?')
sendPrompt('What fields should I save per video in MongoDB?')
sendPrompt('What JSON shape does the backend return to the React frontend?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a YouTube iframe that seeks to a timestamp?')
sendPrompt('How does the download decision work in Viral Video Chopper?')
sendPrompt('How do I use ffmpeg to cut a clip by start/end timestamp in Node.js?')
sendPrompt('How do I redirect the user to save-tube.com with the right timestamp?')
sendPrompt('What does the success state look like after a clip is downloaded?')
